nodes.label: Task 1 Report: Font loading + base @theme tokens
Radius token naming collision fix (stratum- prefix)
nodes.rationale: Bare --radius-sm/md/lg/xl names collided with Tailwind v4's built-in default radius scale keys, which would have silently changed 39 existing rounded-sm/md/lg/xl usages across 14 files; renamed to stratum-prefixed tokens to avoid the collision before those components are re-skinned.

nodes.label: Tailwind v4 @theme tree-shaking behavior
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v4 drops @theme custom property declarations entirely (not just utility classes) when nothing in source references them, so most new tokens correctly do not appear in compiled CSS until consumed by later sub-projects.
